name: Racial Item Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
You can use more various or powerful racial powers through a magic item.

Prerequisite(s): Racial Item Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Racial Item Mastery at 1st mythic tier, plus one additional use at 4th, 7th, and 10th tier. If your race includes different subraces with specific spell-like abilities, you can use your magic item to cast those spell-like abilities instead of your own. If you also expend one use of mythic power, you can cast the mythic version of the selected spell-like ability instead.
